text_block_list.text:
One day, an extraordinarily large box was 
delivered to the Trainer's Office. As I 
stood bewildered, having no recollection 
of ordering it—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Strawberries, melons, papayas, and 
mangoes♡ Plus tons of citrus fruits! Aww♡ 
Mom and Dad, I seriously, seriously love 
you so much~~~~♡"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"What do you think? It's my assorted fruit 
box♪ I had my parents send it to me~!"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry♪ I'll turn it into a 
super-tasty sweet and gobble it right up♡

No sooner had she said that than she began 
pulling out fresh cream and syrup from the 
box one after another—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Just cut, soak, and drizzle it on nice and 
thick, and our super-sweet dessert is all 
done~♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Alright, let's dig in and eat lots♪

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
The sweeter the fruit, the better, so 
there's no tastier way to eat it than 
this♡
choice_data_list:
Well, even so, the calories are a bit 
much...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Fruit is healthy, right? Which basically 
means it has zero calories.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: So no matter how much I eat, no proble~m☆
choice_data_list:
Why don't you share some with everyone 
else too?
You better eat it with proper gratitude!

Make sure you eat with proper gratitude, 
okay?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: So no matter how much I eat, no proble~m☆
choice_data_list:
Why don't you share some with everyone

okay?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's a great idea♪ Food tastes 
better when we eat together anyway!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna go round everyone up. Oh, and 
snacking is seriously forbidden, 'kay~?

After that, I spent an exceedingly sweet 
time together with Fusaichi Pandora's 
friends.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Totes♡ There's not even a millimeter of a 
chance I'd ever forget Papa and Mama's 
love.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Well then, with gratitude for your big 
love, let's dig iiiin♡

And so, Fusaichi Pandora fully indulged in 
her parents' affection and a mind-numbing 
sweetness.
